mapper.select: SELECT id, title, link, icon_code AS icon, channel, resource_type AS resourceType, resource_id AS resourceId, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, create_time AS createTime FROM osh_announcement WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND status IN (0, 2, 4) AND channel = #{channel} AND resource_type = #{resourceType} AND (start_time IS NULL OR start_time <= NOW()) AND (end_time IS NULL OR end_time >= NOW()) ORDER BY sort DESC, IFNULL(update_time, create_time) DESC, create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
